items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Alan Toussaint helped me with this one. He helped. We changed a couple of notes.

ctx.x: On Tudor. Yeah. I just redid a few things. Like I put in that little chime. Uh-huh. And we redid the bass. Now, Alan Toussaint helped me with this one. He helped. We changed a couple of notes. That was off. I think I got. But anyway, Eddie Bow. Okay.
